During his reign, he successfully defended against several Muslim raids and expanded his kingdom, reaching the area of modern-day León. He died in 850.

He was the count of Canosa and a vassal of the Norman prince Robert Guiscard. Osvaldo led the Norman army in the conquest of Apulia and Calabria, and later became the Duke of Apulia in 1057. He was a just ruler and is remembered for his good governance and generosity.
